description: Calculate a complete BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny) chart from birth datetime. Returns the eight characters, Five Elements, Ten Gods, Hidden Stems, Decade Fortune, and more. 根据出生时间计算完整八字命盘。

eightCharProviderSect.description: Late Zi hour config. 1 = next day, 2 = same day (default). 早晚子时：1=明天，2=当天。

lunarDatetime.description: Lunar birth datetime, e.g. "2000-5-5 12:00:00". 农历出生时间。

solarDatetime.description: Birth datetime in ISO format, e.g. "2000-01-15T12:00:00+08:00". 公历出生时间。

name: getBaziChart
